text: 越来越多高学历人才涌入制造业 多所幼师院校开设养老专业 高科技制造业正在吸引越来越多高学历人才加入。同时，越来越多高校开设养老相关专业。
text_en: More highly educated talent entering manufacturing; multiple preschool teacher colleges add elderly care majors. High-tech manufacturing is attracting more highly educated talent. Meanwhile, an increasing number of universities are offering elderly care-related majors.
